description: Get the cross-sectional ranking of stocks by institutional 13F breadth for a quarter. Rank by filer count (default), quarter-over-quarter filer-count change, total published position value, conviction (filers holding it among their ten largest positions) or crowding (high-turnover and private-fund adviser shares as % of shares outstanding), both among stocks 10+ filers hold. Conviction and crowding read the newest closed quarter measured across every 13F book (an open or unmeasured quarter snaps to it, noted). Values use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unvalued. Includes Δ filers, total value, Δ value, and share of the 13F universe. The first complete report quarter is published; earlier rankings and boundary-quarter deltas are unavailable. Only currently-held stocks rank; sold-out names use GetMarketWide13FActivity. During the newest quarter's open filing window, non-filers carry prior-quarter positions (noted in output).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 25, clamped to 1-500)

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-03-31 (defaults to the latest available 13F quarter; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

sort.description: Sort by: 'filers' (default, # of 13F filers desc), 'filersDelta' (QoQ filer-count delta desc — warming names), 'filersDeltaAsc' (QoQ filer-count delta asc — cooling names), 'value' (current total published position value desc), 'conviction' (filers holding it among their ten largest positions desc) or 'crowding' (high-turnover and private-fund adviser shares as % of shares outstanding desc)

name: GetMostHeldStocks
title: Most Widely Held Stocks
